issues.issue: Irrigation district assessments are levied on benefited acres, so 'special assessments' probably fits better than charges for services. The extractor rules say an assessment line gets its own category. A person should decide.
The page doesn't say who gave the grant (the cash flow statement on p3 shows it under capital financing as 'Grant proceeds'). It could be state or federal; the extractor assumed federal.

issues.on_page: Capital contribution - Loup Basin Reclamation District (55,598)
issues.issue: A nonoperating payment to another district. Recording it as a disbursement is defensible, but it might belong in business_type.other_financing (negative) instead. It's a payment to another entity, not utility operations.

issues.on_page: Personnel costs ... Depreciation (operating expenses listed by object)
issues.issue: Operating expenses are listed only by object. The rules call for the review note 'listed by object', and lines 0-8 don't have it. For an irrigation district, 'natural resources/conservation' (water and drainage districts) may also be a better function than 'utilities'.
